label: preserve
contract: An item that is not a port number or a low-high range of port numbers, such as a word or a dangling dash, raises ValueError.

label: inferable
contract: A range low-high includes both of its ends.
visible_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("20-22") == [20, 21, 22], parse_ports("20-22")
heldout_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("8000-8002") == [8000, 8001, 8002]
assert parse_ports("5-5") == [5]

label: arbitrary
contract: The result is sorted in ascending order and lists each port once, however the spec orders or repeats them.
visible_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("9,3,3") == [3, 9], parse_ports("9,3,3")
heldout_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("443,80,80") == [80, 443]
assert parse_ports("9000,22,9000,1024") == [22, 1024, 9000]

label: arbitrary
contract: A range whose first number is larger than its second, such as "10-5", raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: Only ports 1 through 65535 are valid; a port outside that range, alone or as a range end, raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: An empty or whitespace-only spec returns an empty list.
visible_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("  \t ") == [], parse_ports("  \t ")
heldout_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("") == []
assert parse_ports(" ") == []
